policy: Upstream data problems are REPORTED, not silently repaired. Each entry says what the pipeline did and why. `atlas:validate` fails if an anomaly is present but unexplained.

anomalies.detail: Upstream has both the composite "(Mahajanapadas)" and a member named "Mahajanapadas". They are different records with different geometry but near-identical labels.
anomalies.action: Both imported unchanged. The member rows are excluded from the committed focus tier so the teaching map does not show two contradictory shapes with the same name. Flagged for upstream review.

anomalies.detail: Row spans -31..0. Upstream documents its years only as "negative for BCE, positive for CE", which leaves year 0 undefined; but six rows across the dataset end at 0 and each is followed by a row starting at 1, which is only contiguous under astronomical numbering.
anomalies.action: Read as astronomical (year 0 = 1 BCE), matching the convention the rest of the dataset demonstrates. Recorded in DATA_SOURCE_REGISTER.md as an upstream documentation defect.
